target: Make macOS first-install and repair PKGs independent from global or network PyYAML installation while retaining user-transaction updates.
primary_semantics: Probe dependencies as the logged-in user and create an offline isolated Python 3.14 runtime from PKG-bundled PyYAML sources only when required.
invariants: Archive records, summaries, indexes, configuration, and synchronization protocols remain unchanged.
Routine macOS updates continue through the user transaction and never invoke the system Installer.
The installer never writes to Homebrew's externally managed Python environment.
Installation does not download Python dependencies.
allowed_changes: Bundle pure Python PyYAML sources in the macOS PKG, create a user-owned isolated fallback runtime, update release metadata, and add focused regression coverage.
prohibited_changes: Use pip --user, --break-system-packages, global package writes, or installation-time dependency downloads.
Change Windows installation, archive formats, synchronization, summaries, dashboard behavior, or project evidence semantics.
before_after_checks: A logged-in user's existing PyYAML is accepted without creating a runtime.
Missing PyYAML uses only bundled sources in an isolated venv.
Routine updates install through install_macos_transaction.py without /usr/sbin/installer.
Version, documentation, and architecture contracts remain consistent.
